from ortools.sat import sat_parameters_pb2 as sp
    explicit = sp.SatParameters()
    for field, setting in PARAMETERS.items():
        if field == "subsolvers":
            explicit.subsolvers.extend(setting)
        else:
            setattr(explicit, field, setting)
    assert list(explicit.subsolvers) == ["no_lp", "quick_restart_no_lp", "portfolio_no_lp"]
    assert explicit.num_full_subsolvers == 3 and explicit.num_search_workers == 4
    repeated_text, repeated_wire = sp.SatParameters(), sp.SatParameters()
    text_format.Parse(text_format.MessageToString(explicit), repeated_text)
    repeated_wire.ParseFromString(explicit.SerializeToString())
    assert repeated_text.SerializeToString() == repeated_wire.SerializeToString() == explicit.SerializeToString()
    changed_order = sp.SatParameters()
    changed_order.CopyFrom(explicit)
    del changed_order.subsolvers[:]
    changed_order.subsolvers.extend(reversed(PARAMETERS["subsolvers"]))
    assert changed_order.SerializeToString() != explicit.SerializeToString()
    native_absent()
    return {"status": "PASS_TRIANGLE_INCIDENCE_QUERY_INDEPENDENT_INTEGER_AND_RESPONSE_CONTROLS",

replay_order: Apply each before/after replacement in the saved order, requiring exactly count occurrences at that step.
intermediate_placeholder_scope: The substitution ledger records an internal draft placeholder for the CI source, then replaces it in its final step. No placeholder remains in the frozen successor, and no runnable configuration or execution used that intermediate text.
function_comparison_method: Compare complete top-level function source slices directly as text. No Python import, AST parse, compilation or execution.
changes_explained: The accepted-model loader binds the new triangle-incidence producer, complete native checker and corrected native CI source; it checks the new model report/owner/root receipt family, all three appended families and exact unchanged parent restoration.

The parent is the accepted 80,730-variable, 297,470-row model. The successor has the same variables and 300,795 rows. The original edge slice remains 540:68,934, excluding all subsequent auxiliary variables.

The parameter policy now explicitly selects three ordered full-worker subsolvers, no_lp, quick_restart_no_lp and portfolio_no_lp, with num_full_subsolvers=3 and num_search_workers=4. Repeated strings are populated with extend, and complete protobuf parameter messages must match.
Small controls are extended to preserve and distinguish ordered repeated parameters through text and wire round trips. These controls are prepared but have not been run.
Terminal, owner, gate, preflight, independent replay and failure namespaces change to the triangle-incidence query family.

Exact integer vector/domain/linear-row activity evaluation, every saved candidate and additional-vector check, supervisor acceptance, and byte-bound response snapshot/text/wire comparison retain their existing algorithms.
